title: Can I BEAT Passant? [Full Release]
summary: Passant full release, episode 1: setup 4 'Slip and Push' (6 pawns, 2 bishops, king; Slippy and Push badges). He takes Challenging matches, learns that promotions can slip off the board, and clears all three rounds of level 1 (victory by capturing all enemy pieces), earning $8; Game Over/undo and Unstable tiles also shown in frames.
rules: Passant (Steam chess roguelike, full release): pick a starting Setup (1: wall of pawns + king + Courtesan; 2: atomic-like with three knights; 3: start with a Duck; 4 'Slip and Push': 6 pawns + 2 bishops + king with Slippy and Push badges).

Badges = permanent run modifiers, e.g. Push mode (non-capturing move pushes adjacent pieces one square away if space allows; pieces can be pushed off the board), Slippy (a moved piece slides one extra square in its direction if empty; can slip off the board; jumping moves don't slip), Field promotion; boss badges activate in boss rounds.
Coins = one-time consumables, e.g. Pawn coin (demote one enemy piece), Money coin (sell one of your pieces for half its value).
Each level has 3 rounds; before a round choose Standard match, Challenging match (stronger enemy army, more cash) or Skip.
Victory conditions (any one): checkmate; capture all enemy pieces except the king; check the enemy king 6 turns in a row; score +7 material for two turns.
You may move into check, but if the king is captured you lose.

Between rounds: SHOP (piece upgrades e.g. Rainbow Bishop/Pawn, Re-roll $2, Next Round), money rewards per round (e.g. $8); Undo charges ('Undo 1 turn (1 remain)'); special tiles (Unstable, arrow tiles).
A full run = 3 levels (x3 rounds each) ending in boss rounds; Game Over screen 'You made it to stage X, round Y'.
win_condition: Win each round by any victory condition (checkmate / capture all non-king pieces / 6 consecutive checks / +7 material for 2 turns); clear 3 levels.
